messages.text: 'use proactively' marking found — encourages autonomous delegation

writing.overall_comment: A strong, well-scoped frontend subagent definition with clear delegation triggers, boundaries, and output contract, only slightly padded by generic best-practice filler.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: Description clearly signals proactive use for building/styling/refactoring Svelte/React/Vue components, pages, and state logic, so a main agent can route confidently.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, framework-adaptive constraints, workflow, and an explicit output contract (runnable files + summary with assumptions) are all stated clearly.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: Strong scope fences: front-end only, no unauthorized framework/tooling swaps, and precise hand-back conditions for uncertain stacks or design-system work.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Well-structured but somewhat long, with the generic 'should/shouldn't' best-practices block and repeated shadcn guidance adding token weight over the token budget.

suggestions: In the skill instructions, remove or heavily compress the generic 'should/shouldn't' best-practices block that the review flags as adding token weight over budget.
In the same skill, consolidate the repeated shadcn guidance into one canonical section and replace later repetitions with short references.
Across the skill text, tighten wording and remove redundant phrasing to bring conciseness within the token budget while preserving the existing structure.
